blurb: Guests sail on the Skyline Princess, a 120-foot, three-deck yacht with climate-controlled decks and an enclosed rooftop deck, for dinner cruises and private charters. Cruises offer views of landmarks like the Statue of Liberty, Manhattan skyline, Brooklyn Bridge, and Ellis Island. The yacht is designed for all-weather use and can host events from small groups to up to 450 passengers.
